newsitem.title: USA: Search Capital Group changes name.
newsitem.headline: Search Capital Group changes name.

text.p: Search Capital Group on Friday said it has changed its name to Search Financial Services Inc effective as of the close of business on Friday.
Search's publicly-traded securities will be identified with new stock symbols.

Effective at the open of business on Monday, May 19, 1997, Search's common stock symbol will be SFSI and its nine percent/seven percent convertible preferred stock symbol will be SFSIP on the NASDAQ National Market, it said.
